subject: Re: International News Announcement: Dr. Mohammad Seraj Ansari Launches Noble Kids
text:

Thank you for reaching out and sharing the press release regarding the launch of Noble Kids, the children's platform of Noble World Records.

Please note that we do not publish promotional materials or sponsored content free of charge. Our standard rate for publishing promotional articles is ₹5,000 per post.

If you would like us to publish it, you can pay ₹5,000 by UPI:
UPI ID: 9867381971-3@ybl (works with PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM, Amazon Pay, etc.)
Or scan this QR code with any UPI app: [QR image]
Please reply to this email with the payment screenshot, and we will publish your article.

However, if you have any non-promotional news or significant academic events that you believe would be of interest to our readers, please feel free to share those with us for our editorial consideration.

Best regards,
